# HDR JPEG fixture

`ultrahdr.jpg` is libavif v1.3.0's
[`paris_exif_xmp_gainmap_bigendian.jpg`](https://github.com/AOMediaCodec/libavif/blob/v1.3.0/tests/data/paris_exif_xmp_gainmap_bigendian.jpg),
used to exercise JPEG gain-map detection and reconstruction. Its license is
included in `libavif-LICENSE`. Other encoding fixtures are synthesized by tests.
